news.h: C.J. Stroud turned down a big contract. A bigger one awaits
news.d: Sources say C.J. Stroud turned down a deal similar to Trevor Lawrence's. He's in line for a bigger one.

news.h: C.J. Stroud powers Houston Texans vs New York Giants as J.J. McCarthy starts
news.d: — The New York Giants know better than to underestimate the Houston Texans entering Sunday’s matchup even though they’ve won just two games this season.
